<![CDATA[import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

// The gallery and the downloadable template serve the same self-contained document.
export function GET() {
  const html = readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "downloads", "khora.html"), "utf8");
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
}
]]>

/* KHORA / REFERENCE-DIRECTED HERO REFINEMENT — other sections unchanged */
@font-face{font-family:"KhoraEditorial";src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format("woff");font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap}
.header{height:67px;padding:0 clamp(20px,1.6vw,32px);background:rgba(243,244,238,.72);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(27,28,27,.25);backdrop-filter:blur(9px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px);color:#0a0a0b;z-index:110}
.header.dark{background:rgba(17,18,21,.84);border-bottom-color:rgba(246,248,245,.18)}
.header .brand-link{gap:0}
.header .brand-word{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(22px,2.3vw,34px);letter-spacing:.48em;font-weight:400;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
.header .brand-symbol{display:none}
.header .kh-header-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.header .header-center{font:11px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.018em;white-space:nowrap;opacity:.78}
.header .header-center b{font-weight:400}
.header .header-cta{min-height:40px;display:flex;gap:13px;padding:0 19px;border-radius:100px;background:#060707;border-color:#060707;color:#fff;font:13px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.025em}
.header .header-cta:hover{background:#353a39;border-color:#353a39;color:#fff}
.header .header-cta:hover span{color:#fff}
.header.dark .header-cta{background:#f7f8f5;border-color:#f7f8f5;color:#0f1012}
.header.dark .header-cta:hover span{color:#0f1012}
.header .menu-toggle{display:none}
.hero-run{background:#e8e9e3}
.hero-sticky{background:#eaebe6}
.hero-landscape{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 46% at 19% 70%,rgba(188,193,184,.34),transparent 80%),radial-gradient(ellipse 53% 40% at 86% 36%,rgba(190,192,185,.32),transparent 78%),radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 45% 7%,rgba(246,247,242,.8),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(112deg,#e4e7df 0%,#efefea 46%,#dfe2dc 100%)!important;transform:scale(1.08);will-change:transform}
.hero-moss-wash{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 44% 30% at 10% 45%,rgba(251,250,243,.74),transparent 85%),radial-gradient(ellipse 46% 28% at 85% 62%,rgba(242,243,237,.55),transparent 82%),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 65% at 44% 50%,rgba(220,222,214,.20),transparent 82%)!important;pointer-events:none}
.hero-sticky::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.14;mix-blend-mode:multiply;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 250 250' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='grain'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.014' numOctaves='5' seed='13' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23grain)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");background-size:660px 660px}
.hero-frame-corners{position:absolute;inset:84px 24px 20px;pointer-events:none;z-index:8}
.hero-frame-corners i{position:absolute;width:24px;height:24px;opacity:.43}
.hero-frame-corners i:nth-child(1){left:0;top:0;border-left:1px solid #77786f;border-top:1px solid #77786f}
.hero-frame-corners i:nth-child(2){right:0;top:0;border-right:1px solid #77786f;border-top:1px solid #77786f}
.hero-frame-corners i:nth-child(3){left:0;bottom:0;border-left:1px solid #77786f;border-bottom:1px solid #77786f}
.hero-frame-corners i:nth-child(4){right:0;bottom:0;border-right:1px solid #77786f;border-bottom:1px solid #77786f}
.hero-copy{z-index:5;top:clamp(112px,14.5vh,155px);left:0;right:0;max-width:100%;pointer-events:none;transform-origin:center 35%}
.hero-title{font-family:"KhoraEditorial",Georgia,serif!important;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(64px,8.2vw,120px);line-height:.765;letter-spacing:-.049em;text-align:center;max-width:none;margin:0;color:#080909}
.hero-title .line-mask{padding:0;overflow:visible;line-height:.76}
.hero-title .line-mask:nth-child(1){transform:translateX(0)}
.hero-title .line-mask:nth-child(2){transform:translateX(0vw)}
.hero-title .line-mask:nth-child(3){transform:translateX(-17vw)}
.hero-title .line-mask:nth-child(4){transform:translateX(4vw)}
.hero-title .line-mask>span{transform-origin:50% 50%}
.hero-title .line-last>span{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(100px,12vw,210px)}
.hero-coordinate{position:absolute;left:calc(50% + 67px);top:66.2%;z-index:7;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#121313;pointer-events:none}
.hero-bottom{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:clamp(24px,3.1vh,40px);justify-content:center;z-index:8;pointer-events:none}
.hero-bottom .hero-scroll{margin:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:auto;text-decoration:none;color:#17191b;font:11px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.015em}
.hero-scroll-ring{width:49px;height:49px;border:1px solid rgba(12,17,19,.45);outline:1px solid rgba(12,17,19,.14);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:26px "KhoraEditorial",Georgia,serif!important;transition:transform .5s ease,background .5s ease}
.hero-scroll:hover .hero-scroll-ring{transform:translateY(5px);background:#dadbd4}

#khora-root #chambers.chambers-editorial {
  position:relative; isolation:isolate; overflow:hidden; padding:0;
  height:max(710px,100svh); min-height:710px;
  background:#0a0d0e;color:#eeede6;
}
#chambers .chambers-backdrop,#chambers .chambers-rock,#chambers .chambers-steam,#chambers .chambers-vignette{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
}
#chambers .chambers-backdrop{z-index:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 66% 45%,#15252a 0%,#0c1113 49%,#080a0c 82%)}
#chambers .chambers-rock{background-size:cover;background-position:62% 41%;filter:grayscale(.7) saturate(.4) brightness(.45) contrast(1.18);opacity:.28;transform:scale(1.09)}
#chambers .chambers-steam{inset:-12%;background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-size:cover;mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:blur(8px) saturate(.72);opacity:.83;will-change:transform;animation:chambersMistDrift 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#chambers .steam-a{mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 44% 35% at 70% 44%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 44% 35% at 70% 44%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);transform:rotate(-14deg) scale(1.23);opacity:.78}
#chambers .steam-b{mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 29% at 25% 80%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 29% at 25% 80%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);transform:rotate(15deg) scale(1.28);opacity:.62;animation-duration:34s;animation-direction:alternate-reverse}
#chambers .steam-c{mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 36% 29% at 65% 88%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 36% 29% at 65% 88%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.06);opacity:.32;animation-duration:40s;animation-delay:-8s}
#chambers .chambers-vignette{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#080a0d40 0%,#080a0d05 22%,transparent 47%,#07090c40 100%),radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 25%,#06080acc 110%)}
@keyframes chambersMistDrift{from{translate:-4% 1%;scale:1.03}to{translate:5% -4%;scale:1.16}}
#chambers .chambers-frame{position:absolute;inset:84px 23px 24px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
#chambers .chambers-frame i{position:absolute;width:22px;height:22px;opacity:.48}
#chambers .chambers-frame i:nth-child(1){top:0;left:0;border-top:1px solid #c9d2d1aa;border-left:1px solid #c9d2d1aa}
#chambers .chambers-frame i:nth-child(2){top:0;right:0;border-top:1px solid #c9d2d1aa;border-right:1px solid #c9d2d1aa}
#chambers .chambers-frame i:nth-child(3){bottom:0;left:0;border-bottom:1px solid #c9d2d1aa;border-left:1px solid #c9d2d1aa}
#chambers .chambers-frame i:nth-child(4){bottom:0;right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #c9d2d1aa;border-right:1px solid #c9d2d1aa}
#chambers .chambers-editorial-heading{position:absolute;top:clamp(107px,14.2svh,147px);left:clamp(28px,6.8vw,118px);right:7%;z-index:4;pointer-events:none}
#chambers .chambers-location{font-size:clamp(10px,.84vw,12px);letter-spacing:.09em;color:#aab6b3;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:6px 8px;background:#32393782;border:1px solid #7d8e8638;border-radius:5px}
#chambers .chambers-location span{color:#9aa2a0}
#chambers h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(42px,4.55vw,69px);font-weight:400;line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.055em;max-width:1060px;margin:14px 0 0;text-wrap:balance;text-shadow:0 3px 24px #0005}
#chambers .carousel-viewport{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:37%;left:0;width:100%;height:49.2%;min-height:340px;max-height:445px;perspective:1700px;perspective-origin:50% 38%;cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;outline-offset:-4px}
#chambers .carousel-viewport:active{cursor:grabbing}
#chambers .carousel-stage{inset:0;pointer-events:none;transform-style:preserve-3d}
#chambers .chamber-card{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:clamp(228px,20.0vw,282px);height:100%;border:1px solid #f0f2e922;border-radius:6px;background:#172022;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;transform-origin:center center;will-change:transform,opacity;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0008;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:pan-y;transition:border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;outline-offset:3px}
#chambers .chamber-card.is-active{border-color:#e5eae1;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #e5eae160,0 24px 70px #000c,0 0 32px #8faeaa12}
#chambers .chamber-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;filter:brightness(.64) saturate(.69) contrast(1.11);transform:scale(1.03);transition:filter .5s,transform .8s}
#chambers .chamber-card.is-active img{filter:brightness(.88) saturate(.83) contrast(1.08);transform:scale(1)}
#chambers .chamber-card:hover img{filter:brightness(.88) saturate(.89) contrast(1.07)}
#chambers .chamber-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#030608aa 0%,transparent 30%,transparent 61%,#020405b8 100%)}
#chambers .chamber-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8px;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;border:1px solid #ffffff09;border-radius:2px}
#chambers .chamber-card-title{position:absolute;top:17px;left:20px;right:15px;z-index:3;display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,19px);font-weight:400;text-align:left;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.12;color:#f1f2eb;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 2px 14px #0009}
#chambers .chamber-card:not(.is-active) .chamber-card-title{color:#cdd4d1d9}
#chambers .chamber-card-statline{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:11px;right:11px;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:3px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(7px);transition:opacity .35s,transform .35s}
#chambers .chamber-card.is-active .chamber-card-statline{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
#chambers .chamber-card-statline span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(6px,.53vw,8px);color:#e7ece9;letter-spacing:-.03em;border:1px solid #e8eeea5a;border-radius:3px;padding:4px 4px;background:#090f11a8;white-space:nowrap}
#chambers .chambers-editorial-footer{position:absolute;z-index:8;bottom:clamp(30px,4.1svh,48px);left:clamp(33px,3.1vw,52px);right:clamp(44px,25vw,370px);min-height:50px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px}
#chambers .chambers-nav-buttons{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
#chambers .chambers-nav-buttons .carousel-arrow{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0;padding:0;width:34px;height:34px;font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:#e6e7e1;border:0;background:none;transition:transform .25s,color .25s;cursor:pointer}
#chambers .chambers-nav-buttons .carousel-arrow:hover{transform:translateX(-3px);color:white}
#chambers .chambers-nav-buttons .carousel-arrow:last-child:hover{transform:translateX(3px)}
#chambers .chambers-progress-ui{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;width:min(340px,33vw)}
#chambers .chambers-progress-legend{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#dbe2dc;display:flex;gap:6px}
#chambers .chambers-progress-total{color:#84918e}
#chambers #chamber-progress{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;height:3px;border:0;border-radius:0;margin:0;width:100%;cursor:pointer;outline-offset:8px;background:linear-gradient(to right,#e8eee9 0%,#e8eee9 var(--progress-fill,25%),#596561 var(--progress-fill,25%),#596561 100%)}
#chambers #chamber-progress::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:#e6ece6;border:2px solid #091012;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #dbe3de;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
#chambers #chamber-progress:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb,#chambers #chamber-progress:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb{opacity:1}
#chambers #chamber-progress::-moz-range-thumb{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#e6ece6;border:2px solid #091012;opacity:0}
#chambers #chamber-progress:hover::-moz-range-thumb,#chambers #chamber-progress:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb{opacity:1}
#chambers .chambers-drag-badge{width:64px;height:64px;border:1px solid #dce5dfb9;border-radius:50%;position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 26px);top:-6px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#ecf1e9;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:-.02em;background:#1822246c;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);pointer-events:none}
#chambers .chambers-drag-badge i{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;background:#cfdcd2;border-radius:50%;top:-3px;left:15px;box-shadow:0 0 8px #cadbd28e}
#khora-root.chambers-view .mist-canvas,#khora-root.chambers-view .page-progress,#khora-root.chambers-view .custom-scroll{opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none}
#khora-root.chambers-view .dock{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,150%);transition:opacity .32s ease,transform .5s ease}
#khora-root.chambers-view .header{height:68px;background:rgba(8,10,12,.92);border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4ed32;transform:translateY(0)!important;color:var(--paper)}
#chambers .visually-hidden{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;border:0;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap}

    <div class="strata-depth-graphic"><div class="depth-ticks"></div><div class="depth-dot"></div><span class="mono">DEPTH</span><strong id="strata-depth">−14</strong><small class="mono">METERS</small></div>
    <div class="strata-content">
      <div class="strata-panel is-current" data-step="0"><span class="eyebrow mono">01—03 / LAYER ONE</span><h2>Where stone<br/><em>begins to breathe.</em></h2><p>Within porous basalt, the first veil of geothermal warmth gathers in absolute stillness.</p><div class="strata-stat mono"><span>−14 M</span><span>POROUS BASALT</span></div></div>
      <div class="strata-panel" data-step="1"><span class="eyebrow mono">02—03 / LAYER TWO</span><h2>Water holds<br/><em>the ancient light.</em></h2><p>Mineral-rich silica water receives the filtered memory of rock and time.</p><div class="strata-stat mono"><span>−38 M</span><span>MINERAL SILICA SPRINGS</span></div></div>
      <div class="strata-panel" data-step="2"><span class="eyebrow mono">03—03 / LAYER THREE</span><h2>At the edge<br/><em>of deep time.</em></h2><p>Heat from the volcanic bedrock surrounds the most secluded chamber of the sanctuary.</p><div class="strata-stat mono"><span>−84 M</span><span>MAGMA BEDROCK VAULT</span></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="strata-quote" id="strata-quote" aria-label="Human bodies immersed in mineral waters filtered through four hundred years of volcanic rock."></div>
    <div class="strata-dots" aria-hidden="true"><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></div>
    <div class="basalt-exit" aria-hidden="true"><div class="cube cube-a"></div><div class="cube cube-b"></div><div class="cube cube-c"></div><div class="cube cube-d"></div><div class="cube cube-e"></div><div class="cube cube-f"></div><div class="cube cube-g"></div><div class="cube cube-h"></div></div>

  <section id="architecture" class="architecture section-light" data-theme="light">
   <div class="architecture-top mono"><span>03 / THE INVISIBLE ARCHITECTURE</span><span>CARVED, NOT ASSEMBLED</span></div>
   <div class="architecture-copy"><span class="mono eyebrow">THE BUILDING IS THE LAND.</span><h2>Nothing added.<br/><em>Everything revealed.</em></h2><p>A sanctuary not placed upon the earth, but discovered within it. Each void is defined by the geology that surrounds it.</p></div>
   <div class="architecture-view" id="architecture-view"><div class="model-halo"></div><div class="model-inner" id="model-inner"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Isometric model of KHORA’s subterranean chambers carved into volcanic basalt"/></div><div class="model-orbit orbit-one"></div><div class="model-orbit orbit-two"></div><div class="hotspot-layer" id="hotspot-layer"><button class="hotspot" data-hotspot="0" aria-label="Explore the entrance threshold"><span>01</span></button><button class="hotspot" data-hotspot="1" aria-label="Explore the thermal basin"><span>02</span></button><button class="hotspot" data-hotspot="2" aria-label="Explore the mineral chamber"><span>03</span></button><button class="hotspot" data-hotspot="3" aria-label="Explore the bedrock vault"><span>04</span></button></div></div>
   <div class="architecture-detail" id="architecture-detail"><span class="mono" id="architecture-num">LOCATOR / 01</span><strong id="architecture-title">Surface threshold</strong><p id="architecture-desc">A solitary incision invites visitors below the volcanic plateau.</p><div class="detail-foot mono">INTERACTIVE SECTION MODEL <span>↗</span></div></div>
   <div class="architecture-footer mono"><span>01 / BASALT MASSING STUDY</span><span>ROTATE WITH POINTER · SELECT A NODE</span></div>
  </section>
  <section class="values-section section-light" id="values" data-theme="light"><div class="values-grid"><div class="values-aside"><span class="mono section-index">04 / SLOW GEOLOGY</span><h2>Time is<br/><em>the material.</em></h2><p>Long before there was architecture, water and heat were already shaping the stone.</p></div><div class="values-statement"><p>Before the first stone was cut, the Earth had already begun the work. What remains is an invitation to <em>experience the time between.</em></p><div class="values-line"></div><div class="specimen-figure"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Specimens of basalt, moss, pale silica and mineral deposits" loading="lazy"/><span class="mono">MATTER / BASALT / SILICA / LICHEN</span></div></div></div></section>
  <section class="chronology section-dark" id="chronology" data-theme="dark"><div class="chronology-header"><span class="mono section-index">05 / THE CYCLE</span><h2>450 years,<br/><em>one drop of water.</em></h2><p>A conceptual journey through volcanic rainwater filtration, measured in geological rather than human time.</p></div><div class="time-track" id="time-track" role="region" aria-label="Draggable timeline of geothermal water cycle" tabindex="0"><div class="time-cards" id="time-cards"><article class="time-card"><span class="mono">001 / PRECIPITATION</span><div class="time-art time-art-one"><i class="rain"></i></div><h3>It begins<br/><em>above ground.</em></h3><p>Cold rain settles into the porous volcanic landscape.</p><span class="mono">SURFACE / 0M</span></article><article class="time-card"><span class="mono">002 / INFILTRATION</span><div class="time-art time-art-two"><i></i></div><h3>Below the<br/><em>visible world.</em></h3><p>Water travels slowly through dark layers of basalt.</p><span class="mono">BEDROCK / −14M</span></article><article class="time-card"><span class="mono">003 / MINERALIZATION</span><div class="time-art time-art-three"><i></i></div><h3>The long<br/><em>conversation.</em></h3><p>Rock, heat, and pressure leave their trace in the water.</p><span class="mono">SILICA / −38M</span></article><article class="time-card"><span class="mono">004 / GEOTHERMAL RISE</span><div class="time-art time-art-four"><i></i></div><h3>Heat returns<br/><em>to the surface.</em></h3><p>The geological cycle becomes a moment of human stillness.</p><span class="mono">THERMAL / 38.4°C</span></article></div></div><div class="timeline-foot mono"><span>← DRAG THROUGH DEEP TIME →</span><div><button id="time-prev" aria-label="Timeline previous">←</button><button id="time-next" aria-label="Timeline next">→</button></div></div></section>
  <section class="residence section-light" id="residence" data-theme="light"><div class="residence-image"></div><div class="residence-grid"><div><span class="mono">06 / PRIVATE RESIDENCY</span><h2>A place to<br/><em>remain a while.</em></h2></div><p>Fourteen contemplative suites.
